name: Funding Settlement Drift
thesis: Funding settles at 00:00, 08:00 and 16:00 UTC. Traders holding the paying side reduce into settlement to avoid the charge and re-add after it, which produces a mechanical unwind-and-restore around those fixed hours that has nothing to do with valuation.
invalidation: Retire if worst-symbol out-of-sample profit factor stays below 1.0 over 30 trades, or if the mechanism's driving series stops being published.
